population_scope: all decisions; the matched-historical-population rates used in the policy comparison are in mart_routing_evaluation and policy_comparison.csv
unmet_demand_note: A mandatory-specialist lead with no eligible regional or national specialist is held in Q-NSP; it is never given to a generalist.
source_models: dbt marts: mart_lead_priority, mart_routing_candidate, mart_routing_recommendation_static, mart_routing_exception, mart_routing_evaluation
statistical_unit: routing decision (one lead at one routing-decision timestamp)
evidence_eligibility: every synthetic routing-decision timestamp, plus one intake-routability review per lead the routing engine never saw
limitations: Hypothetical rules for a fictional bank over entirely synthetic CRM data. Rule-adherence, counterfactual and operational-exposure comparisons only; never evidence of a causal effect on conversion, revenue, profitability or customer experience. Recommendations never consume capacity, so every decision is evaluated against the capacity the historical policy produced.
